_comment: Per-council verification of WHICH DCP is currently in force, done from each council's own
page rather than from the Planning Portal register. The runbook is emphatic that the register
is good for discovery and useless for currency, and every council checked so far confirms it.
This file is the record of step 0 of docs/dcp-onboarding-runbook.md. It is committed because
the verification is manual and expensive, and redoing it for 30 councils because nobody wrote
it down is the failure this exists to prevent.
register_says is quoted from public/EPI/nsw-dcp/dcp-register.json so the drift is visible.
